page.overview:
Who is Alien 2?

Alien 2 is a man dressed as an alien for a commercial for the Bi-Mon-Sci-Fi-Con. He encourages viewers along with Phil to visit the convention due to robot fights and the presence of Mark Hamill. Unlike Phil, who talks using an exaggerated, alien-sounding voice, he speaks in a normal human voice.
